head: Something has to change for the Jets
paras: The Jets are winless in seven (0-5-2). The Panthers have won two in a row, the last a 5-1 rout of Winnipeg. The Cats won the first meeting this season, 5-1 in Winnipeg.
At home, Paul Maurice likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Jets’ first line. The Panthers’ power play has a soft target in the Jets’ kill.

items.text: The Panthers have been without Jacob Markström, Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games. Akira Schmid is expected to start.
The Jets have been without Josh Morrissey since Oct 7.
Brady Tkachuk has a point in five straight games against Winnipeg.
Mark Scheifele has five goals in seven games against Florida since 2023-24.

FLA.head: The Panthers should have the upper hand
FLA.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage, and Winnipeg is on the second night of a back-to-back and will be without Morrissey. The Jets’ way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.

WPG.head: Not an easy night for the Jets
WPG.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage, and Winnipeg is on the second night of a back-to-back and will be without Morrissey. The Jets’ best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.

calls.head: The Panthers will send Ekblad and Forsling at Scheifele
calls.body: At home, the Panthers keep sending Ekblad and Forsling out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Paul Maurice has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Jets’ first line is Connor, Scheifele and Perfetti.

calls.head: The Panthers come in rested
calls.body: It’s the Jets’ second game in two nights. Teams on the back end of those usually spend more time defending, so we think the Panthers get more of the play than usual.

calls.head: The Panthers’ power play has a target
calls.body: The Panthers’ power play is near the top of the league, and the Jets’ kill is near the bottom. Every trip to the box hurts the Jets more than most.
